label_note: Packet/family labels provide navigation, not new discovery IDs.
review_scope: Exactly four completed source reviews, with a separately accepted second review for Jordan jets.

families.accepted: Selected transfer rank is bounded by vertex-disjoint path capacity; the totally nonsingular forced Schur half-rectangle therefore has superconcentrator support. Classical depth-two and depth-three edge bounds and generic-weight existence are accepted at their stated scope.
qualifications: Finite scalar linear DAG and source/sink normalization; all minors, not merely invertibility.
Edge-depth two gives Omega(N log^2 N/log log N) total edges; edge-depth three gives Omega(N log log N). These are complete-evaluator edge bounds, not unrestricted arithmetic lower bounds.
Generic assignment is guaranteed over infinite fields; finite fields need size/extension qualifications. Fourier-compatible assigned weights are not supplied.
A half-rectangle is only a necessary subproblem; field, full evaluator, coefficient preparation and cost obligations remain.
Source depth routine mishandles arbitrary edge storage order; supplied examples are not invalidated.
families.novelty: classical ingredients; application priority not certified

families.accepted: Dimension-free Taylor lift, finite-word outer error ledger, fixed-accuracy O_epsilon(N log N/log log N) and inverse-polylog-accuracy O_a(N log N/log log log N), O(N) words, and exact correction rank N/gcd(N,L).
qualifications: Represented dyadic inputs, polynomial dynamic range, Theta(log N)-bit address-capable word RAM, all cold preparation and outputs charged.
Deterministic all-input relative l2 approximation; not exact complex arithmetic or per-bin relative error.
The already accepted interpolation compiler is all-length and has the stronger inverse-polylog accuracy bound O(N log N/log log N). Preserve its precision safeguards.
Source reference is on-demand accuracy code, not a certified eager-table production runtime.
Fresh spectral controls are numerical corroboration, not interval spectral proofs; exact geometry, schedules and finite-field ranks are separate.
families.novelty: unresolved after bounded model-matched primary-source comparison; no discovery count increment

families.accepted: For N>=2, a common entrywise sector of width W<pi gives the stated operator-norm obstruction after arbitrary invertible complex outer monomial gauges; nonnegative-mixer and jointly dephasable damped Green-cycle specializations follow.
qualifications: One common cone is essential; use effective mask phases after stage dephasing.
Cycle magnitude product must be strictly below one and each stage union must admit a common potential.
Balanced gain-graph switching is classical, including the spanning-tree proof.
O(N+q) counts graph and histogram preprocessing in the modular-word model only; exact threshold comparison, magnitude validation, phase extraction and bit costs remain separate.
Inconclusive potential or threshold tests are not universal rejection or synthesis certificates.
Earlier unitary real-collinear exclusion and unrestricted complex phase-averaging construction remain unchanged.
families.novelty: precise synthesis priority unresolved; classical gain-graph lemma not new

families.accepted: Full and interval spectral recurrences; bounded-order grid-frequency raw-input recognition and transform work O(N R^2+R^3) over supplied-root fields with the characteristic and 2R<=N assumptions.
qualifications: Fixed structural order gives linear work only on the stated family.
Positive-characteristic exponential-generating form needs d<characteristic; binomial recurrence avoids factorial division.
Greedy piecewise algorithm certifies accepted inputs but can reject genuine short-segment structured inputs.
Use the explicit finite-field union bound; subspace dimension alone does not establish properness over finite fields.
Ordinary N-output baseline is cheaper in all displayed large source comparisons; crossover belongs to a different padded 2N-output task.
No source benchmark execution, universal FFT, numerical stability, bit-complexity or historical-priority certification.
families.novelty: q-holonomic and generalized Prony ingredients classical; specialization priority unverified
